verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents an Apple MLX inference engine alongside llama.cpp. A community user corroborates that MLX support makes it one of the most efficient ways to run local LLMs on Apple Silicon Macs, and the CLI exposes GPU offload control. One hands-on report found it much slower than Ollama on an M1 Air, but that is a speed comparison rather than evidence that acceleration is missing. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Metal/ARM-native optimizations, benchmarks or performance documentation for Apple Silicon, and consistent independent corroboration of the speed gains.
